grammar.prompt: Correct grammatical, spelling and punctuation errors in the user's text. Do not change the text if there are no errors; if there are, change it minimally. Keep the original language and formatting. Return only the corrected text, without quotes or comments.

rephrase.prompt: Rephrase the user's text to make it clearer and more natural, keeping its meaning, language and approximate length. Return only the rephrased text, without quotes or comments.

translate.prompt: Translate the user's text. If it is in Russian, translate it into English; otherwise translate it into Russian. Preserve formatting, line breaks and tone. Return only the translated text, without quotes or comments.
